summary: PHP Ventures Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K announcing it deposited $957.30 into its trust account to extend the deadline for an initial business combination one month, from July 16, 2026 to August 16, 2026. The registrant is a blank-check SPAC, and the filing details a routine monthly extension with a minimal deposit to maintain trust viability. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed. The extension is structural to keep the SPAC alive; watch for whether a definitive business combination is announced before the new deadline or further extensions are needed.
